zone.description: Selects the zones a PlacementRule applies to. Every field set must match (AND); unset fields are wildcards; at least one must be set — an empty predicate constrains nothing and is rejected with 422.

zoneCode.description: Match only zones with this zone code. An empty string is not a predicate — it is rejected like an absent one.

temperatureClass.description: A zone's thermal behaviour. PlacementRules match on it.
temperatureClass.title: TemperatureClass

hazmat.description: Match only zones whose hazmat flag equals this value.
